# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the current version deployed at
https://fabjun.github.io/soundboard-of-storytelling/ receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security issues in public issues or pull requests.

- Preferred: use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting —
  [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/Fabjun/soundboard-of-storytelling/security/advisories/new).
- Alternatively, email soundboard_of_storytelling@pm.me.

Please include a description of the issue, the steps to reproduce it and the affected
version (shown on the app's start screen).

## Scope

The app runs entirely in the browser and stores all data locally on the device. There is
no server-side component and no user account. Relevant reports concern, for example, the
web app itself, its service worker, or the build and deployment pipeline of this
repository.
